description_en: Rebuild the staging environment of an edge container application
description_zh: 重新构建边缘容器应用的测试环境
name: RebuildEdgeContainerAppStagingEnv

parameters.help_en:
The application ID. You can call the [ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~) operation to obtain the application ID.
<notice>This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns InvalidParameter.appid (400). You can call ListEdgeContainerApps to obtain a valid application ID.
Dependency chain: CreateEdgeContainerApp (if not created) → CreateEdgeContainerAppVersion → PublishEdgeContainerAppVersion (environment=staging) → RebuildEdgeContainerAppStagingEnv
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID，可使用[ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~)接口获取应用ID。
<notice>此参数为实际必填项，未提供时 API 返回 InvalidParameter.appid(400)；可通过 ListEdgeContainerApps 获取有效应用ID。
依赖链：CreateEdgeContainerApp（如未创建） → CreateEdgeContainerAppVersion → PublishEdgeContainerAppVersion（环境=staging）→ RebuildEdgeContainerAppStagingEnv
</notice>
parameters.name: app_id
